Project overview

Laguna Park 2 is a three-storey townhouse and villa enclave by Laguna Property beside the Laguna resort complex in Choeng Thale, completed in 2023. Owners get Laguna resort privileges such as club membership and shuttle access.

Facilities & amenities

  • Swimming pool
  • Fitness centre
  • Rest area
  • Parking
  • 24-hour security
  • CCTV
  • Restaurants and bar
  • XANA Beach Club
  • Free shuttle bus and ferry between Laguna resorts
  • Sanctuary Club membership
  • 5 years free Laguna Phuket Golf Club membership
